g.text: e Separate energy diagnostic: same decay window
1980–2022 monthly means. Arrival integrates Jan 15–Jun 15; decay uses next Jan 15–May 15.
Unresolved is a volume residual. Surface heat loss (ZJ) is not an additive volume term.
